herald-of-the-sun.title: Herald of the Sun notes
items: Right after {Wake of Ashes}, apply {Dawnlight} with 2 Holy Power abilities. Thanks to {Aurora}, the first one is free
On big pulls, extend {Dawnlight} with {Divine Storm} ({Endless Gleam}) and position so the {Sun's Avatar} beams pass through enemies

templar.title: Templar notes
items: Use {Hammer of Light} right after {Wake of Ashes}; if the free {Light's Deliverance} proc comes right before {Avenging Wrath}, hold it briefly
Use {Wake of Ashes} right before a one-shot mechanic to get the {Sacrosanct Crusade} shield, and add {Divine Protection} if it's dangerous

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on every Ssscavenging shield. Use Execution Sentence (1 min) and Wake of Ashes (30 sec) on every shield, and press Avenging Wrath (2 min) on a shield whenever it is back (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Line up Divine Protection (42 sec) with Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone) and take it with the Shield of Vengeance barrier (Topicx)
[해제] Regurgitate is a disease, so clear hit party members with Cleanse Toxins
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Rebuke (15 sec) into the kick rotation for the three back-to-back Toxic Atrophy casts, and set the order in chat before the pull (Topicx)

[광역 피해] When Uncoil splits the boss into five Uncoiled Writhes, press Avenging Wrath with Bloodlust and pour Execution Sentence and Divine Storm into them. Stop any Writhe moving toward its Spiteful Hunt target with Hammer of Justice (Topicx)
[해제] Clear the Spiteful Venom poison on Spiteful Hunt targets with Cleanse Toxins
Zul'jan: [위치] If your beam spot is far away, reach it with Divine Steed before the Ritual of the Fang channel, and press Divine Protection during the 8 sec you block the beam to reduce the Nature damage taken every second (Topicx)

[참고] When you deliberately take Boneslicer or a slowed Axegrinder axe to clear Ritual Venom, press Divine Protection if your health is low. Do not use Blessing of Protection or Divine Shield then, because they also block that Physical damage and the stacks stay (Topicx·Icy Veins)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt does not need a kick rotation. Kick it when Rebuke is available (Topicx)
[위치] Press Divine Protection when you step into Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam, and leave the 50% slow zone with Divine Steed when the beam ends
[회피] Escape the Lightsower Dash path with your remaining Divine Steed charge (2 charges with Cavalier)
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Free allies held by Bloodthorn Roots with Blessing of Freedom (Wowhead)
[참고] Blessing of Protection on the Bloodthirsty Gaze target can block the attack at the end of the chase (Wowhead). Do not use it on the tank

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Thorncaller Roar's 6 sec AoE and during Lightcrazed Frenzy after 50%. Bloodlust goes out below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active, so line up Avenging Wrath with it (Topicx)
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Rebuke into the kick rotation for the Warden's Wrath that Ruia repeats on the tank in Moonkin Form

[해제] When a DPS or healer still bleeding from Grievous Thrash is marked by Pulverizing Strikes, cast Blessing of Protection on them to clear the bleed and block the 6 sec physical cones (164870 every 2 sec) (Wowhead)

[광역 피해] If you are marked by Pulverizing Strikes, stand still and take the cones with Divine Protection. Save Divine Shield (3.5 min with Unbreakable Spirit) as an emergency button for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Rebuke the Lashers' Lightspore Shot before the rebirth. Reborn Lashers are immune to interrupts
[광역 피해] When Awaken the Lightbloom groups up the Lashers, hit them with Wake of Ashes and Divine Storm

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Cleanse Toxins the Toxic Spores poison stacked from stepping on Spoiled Supplies mushrooms (Wowhead)
[위치] Use Divine Steed to step on distant mushrooms within 12 sec
[광역 피해] Pop Divine Protection for Ravenous Bellow's party-wide physical damage
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Rebuke into the Fractured Shivercore Winter's Shroud interrupt rotation
[회피] Use Divine Steed to dodge Raging Squall on the ice or to get into Snowdrift
Nalorakk: [위치] When you are marked by Echoing Maul, reach a corner not used this set with Divine Steed within 4 sec, and press Divine Protection (42 sec) for the 8 yd Nature damage (193965) the Echo deals when it lands (Topicx)

[위치] During Fury of the War God, get into an Echo's charge path first with Divine Steed and block it. If Divine Protection is not back from Echoing Maul, take Echoing Fury with the Templar build's Sacrosanct Crusade barrier
[참고] Take Overwhelming Onslaught (three armor-ignoring Physical hits) behind Zul'jarra's shield, and press Divine Protection in advance if your health is low

Kystia Manaheart: [광역 피해] Line up Avenging Wrath, Execution Sentence and Wake of Ashes all within the 20 sec of Destabilized
[차단] Use Rebuke and Hammer of Justice on the Mirror Images clones' Felstorm; if the clones are grouped, stop several with Blinding Light
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] When the boss comes out, press Avenging Wrath with the second Bloodlust (Topicx). Killing Spree is armor-ignoring Physical damage, so Blessing of Protection can make an endangered party member immune to it (Wowhead)
[해제] The Heartstop Poison applied to the tank after Envenom is a poison, so clear it with Cleanse Toxins (Wowhead)

[위치] Hide behind the nearest barrel during Murder in a Row. Several players can share one barrel, so do not run to a distant empty one. A shot barrel explodes 5 sec later, so leave it with Divine Steed (Topicx)
Xathuux the Annihilator: [광역 피해] The boss takes 30% more damage during the 15 sec of Demonic Rage, so line up Execution Sentence every time, and save Avenging Wrath for the second Demonic Rage where the third Bloodlust goes out (Topicx)
[참고] If the tank is in danger under Legion Strike's healing reduction, use Blessing of Sacrifice
[회피] Spread before Infernal Crush, and press Divine Protection if the axe is still alive
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Rebuke into the kick rotation for Chaos Bolt
[제어] Wild Imps and Furious Vilefiends are demons and are stunned for 5 sec by Wake of Ashes. Aim Wake of Ashes at the Wild Imps gathered by Fingers of Gul'dan to stop Felfire Burst
[광역 피해] Damage cooldowns go on the adds, not the boss. Line up Avenging Wrath and Divine Toll with Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imp spawns (Topicx)

Taz'Rah: [회피] Nether Dash lines follow their target, so when a line appears do not move much and stand where it does not cross other players' lines. Dodge the orbs flying from Void Fissures during Dark Bloom with Divine Steed (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Dark Bloom (174568 Shadow to everyone) is the biggest group damage in this fight, so line up Divine Protection with it (Topicx)

The Golden Serpent: [제어] Lock down Animated Gold packs with Blinding Light and kill them with Divine Storm
[광역 피해] Pop Divine Protection for Serpentine Gust AoE damage
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Rebuke into the kick rotation for Half-Finished Mummy and Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out on this boss, so line up Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence with it at the start, and press Divine Protection for Awakening Slam (193965 Shadow to the group) (Topicx)
[해제] Remove a Wretched Discharge disease that slipped through the kicks with Cleanse Toxins

[차단] Put Rebuke into the kick rotation for Zanazal's Poison Nova, and remove the poison DoT with Cleanse Toxins if it goes through
[참고] Blessing of Protection on the Barrel Through target blocks the armor-ignoring Physical damage (Wowhead). Using it on the tank drops threat, so do not use it on the tank
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out at the start of Dazar, so stack Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence on Reban to kill it before 80%, and put Rebuke into the kick rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar. On a four-Bloodlust route, line up Avenging Wrath with the phase 2 Bloodlust (Topicx)

[참고] After 80%, when Blade Combo follows T'zala's Savage Maul (193965 Physical and a 10 sec bleed) on the tank, use Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank. Wowhead suggests Blessing of Protection for Savage Maul, but it drops the tank's threat, so use it only when a non-tank party member is hit
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Gilded Destruction (155172 Fire to the group and a 15 sec Fire DoT), and use Divine Shield if your health is in danger

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice lands and drags the boss out of the ice (Topicx). Use Rebuke only as a backup when the tank misses the kick
[광역 피해] Line up Execution Sentence and Wake of Ashes on the Ice Bulwark in the 66% and 33% intermissions to break it fast

Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Rebuke into the kick rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[우선 처치] The Firestorm must die before the next Molten Boulder to keep floor space clear, so stack Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on the Firestorm (Topicx)
[회피] When Burnout (5 sec cast, 484912 Fire within 20 yd) comes as the Firestorm dies, leave 20 yd with Divine Steed, and press Divine Protection if you are late
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [우선 처치] When Kyrakka lands, put Execution Sentence on the dragon, and save Avenging Wrath for phase 2

[위치] If you get Inferno Spit, use Divine Steed to go to the platform edge on the side of the next Winds of Change, and press Divine Protection when the circle explodes for 8 yd as the 6 sec DoT ends (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [참고] Only use Execution Sentence on a boss without Storm Blessed, and hold it if the immunity is about to move
[광역 피해] Pop Divine Protection for the Thunder and Lightning soak after Gale Force
Merektha: [참고] Blessing of Protection on an A Knot of Snakes target in advance prevents it (Wowhead)
[차단] Use Rebuke on Toxic Viper's Poison Spit, and remove the poison with Cleanse Toxins if it lands
[광역 피해] After Hatch, put Execution Sentence on the Storm Serpent first since it has twice the health, and press Divine Protection for Serpentstorm (knockback, 116379 Nature and an 8 sec DoT) (Topicx)
Galvazzt: [위치] During Lightning Spire beam soak swaps, reduce Galvanized damage with Divine Protection and move between spire spots with Divine Steed
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Line up Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence on the Essence Defiler to kill it fast
[차단] Twisted Hexxer is immune to crowd control, so only Rebuke can stop Flame Shock. The tank gathers the Hexxer next to the Corrupted Guardian, so hit them together with Divine Storm (Topicx)
[위치] In phase 2, stop the Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer with Hammer of Justice, and run to the green orbs they drop on death with Divine Steed and step on them right away (Topicx)

파멸의 재 시전 후에 신성한 목적이 부여됩니다.

신성한 목적
신성한 힘을 소모하는 능력이 신성한 힘을 소모하지 않으며 공격력과 치유량 10%만큼 증가

(2초 재사용 대기시간)

1253598.d:
응징의 격노 사용 시 가속이 2%만큼 증가합니다.

응징의 격노의 지속시간 동안 소모한 신성한 힘 하나당 가속이 추가로 2%만큼, 최대 20%만큼 증가합니다.

1261159.d: [정의로운 이유 / 전쟁의 기술]이 추가로 심판의 칼날을 강화해, 사용 시 신성 마력을 방출하여 주 대상에게 [(전투력의 331.918%) * 2.5]의 신성 피해를 입히고 이동 경로상의 다른 모든 적에게는 (전투력의 331.918%)의 신성 피해를 입히게 합니다.

1261562.d:
신의 가호가 받는 피해를 추가로 10%만큼 감소시키고 복수의 방패를 시전합니다.

복수의 방패
신성한 빛의 방벽을 만들어 10초 동안 [30 / 100 * 총 생명력 * (1 + 유연성)]의 피해를 흡수합니다.

방벽이 사라지면, 폭발하여 그때까지 흡수한 모든 피해를 주위에 있는 모든 적에게 신성 피해로 고르게 나누어 입힙니다.

1263787.d:
새벽빛이 천상의 폭풍 또는 기사단의 선고에 적중당할 때마다 지속시간이 0.3초만큼 증가합니다.

2개의 새벽빛에 천상의 폭풍이 적중하면 지속시간이 추가로 0.5초만큼 증가합니다.

1306161.d: 신성한 목적을 소모하면 천상의 심판관이 부여됩니다. 천상의 심판관은 다른 신성한 힘을 사용하는 능력을 강화하여, 주 대상에게 빛의 심판관을 내보내 (전투력의 1012.5%)의 신성 피해를 입히고 8미터 내의 적에게는 (전투력의 472.5%)의 신성 피해를 입히게 합니다. 천상의 심판관이 활성화된 동안에는 발동하지 않습니다. (200밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

1: [차단] Put Rebuke (15 sec) into the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy) so the Spellsower keeps walking to the tank. If it runs to a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, stop it with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 6 sec stun) to prevent Frantic Blooming.

[광역 피해] Once everything is stacked and Bloodlust is up, press Avenging Wrath (2 min) and add Wake of Ashes, Divine Toll and Execution Sentence. For Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec), press Divine Protection (42 sec with Unbreakable Spirit) to take 30% less damage for 8 sec and gain the Shield of Vengeance barrier.

[참고] When Spore Spines slows from the 13 Lashers stack on the tank, cast Blessing of Freedom (25 sec) on the tank so they ignore movement impairing effects for 8 sec. Unbound Freedom gives you the same effect.
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley, kick one with Rebuke and stun the other with Hammer of Justice to stop its cast.

[우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher activates its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108, immune to crowd control), Hammer of Justice no longer works on it. Focus Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on that Lasher and break the shield first.

[광역 피해] Use Divine Protection for Spouting Floret. If the Divine Protection from pull 1 (42 sec) is not back yet, the Templar build can press Wake of Ashes to gain the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier (10% of max health) and take it with that.
3: [차단] Kick the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley with Rebuke, and save Hammer of Justice to stop any Spellsower that runs with Call The Grove.
[참고] If the tank slows down from the 12 Lashers' Spore Spines or from Virid Grovekeeper's Ruptured Earth (40% slow), cast Blessing of Freedom on the tank.
5: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) with Rebuke. If it goes off, the whole group is disoriented for 3 sec.
[제어] When Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap, stun it with Hammer of Justice to stop the cone attacks it repeats every 2 sec for 6 sec (193965 Physical, knockback).
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. If Avenging Wrath is ready, press it once Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later.
7: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Rebuke, and kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot when Rebuke is spare.
[제어] Hammer of Justice (30 sec) can stop only one of the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap. Share the second Saptor with another party member's stun.

[참고] When Grievous Gash bleeds from the two Luminous Thornmaws stack on the tank, cast Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min) on the tank to take 30% of their damage for 12 sec. The bleed only ends at full health, so you can spend spare Holy Power on Word of Glory for the tank.
8: [제어] Stun whichever Thorny Saptor jumps in first with Thornclaw Leap using Hammer of Justice.

[광역 피해] Timing Divine Protection for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret lets the Shield of Vengeance barrier also absorb Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield reflect (4849 Nature per hit), and it bursts for Holy damage equal to the amount absorbed when it ends.
[차단] Kick the two Leafy Grovecrawlers' Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast) when Rebuke is spare.
10: [해제] Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew poison (67888 Nature, then 58189 Nature every 1.5 sec for 9 sec) can be removed with Cleanse Toxins. Its 8 sec cooldown lets you cleanse only one player at a time, so split targets with the healer.

[우선 처치] When Potadpole Eggs appear, break them quickly with Divine Toll (up to 5 targets within 30 yd) and Divine Storm. Put Execution Sentence (1 min) on the Matriarch and save Avenging Wrath for pull 12.
11: [차단] When the three Lightfeather Petalwings stack and cast Disorienting Screech, disorient them together with Blinding Light (1.5 min, 6 sec disorient within 10 yd) to stop the casts, and kick the rest with Rebuke. The disorient breaks on damage.
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Spouting Floret. When Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash stacks on the tank, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank again if the one from pull 7 (2 min) is back.
12: [우선 처치] When the six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, line up Avenging Wrath for this pull and put Execution Sentence on a Lasher in the middle of the pack so its 10 yd blast chips all the shields together.
[차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice. Shielded Lashers are immune to crowd control, so do not spend the stun on a Lasher.
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, and cast Blessing of Freedom on the tank when Spore Spines slows from the six Lashers stack on them.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with Rebuke (15 sec). If kicks run short, stun the second Serpent with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 6 sec stun) to stop its cast.

[제어] If the seven Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed with Ravenous Claws and the tank starts taking heavy damage, hold the pack with Blinding Light (1.5 min, 6 sec disorient within 10 yd). Damage breaks it, but just 2 sec without melee swings drops the 2 sec stacks.

[광역 피해] It is the first pull, so press Avenging Wrath (2 min) and add Wake of Ashes, Divine Toll and Execution Sentence. If Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots DoT (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec) hurts, press Divine Protection (42 sec with Unbreakable Spirit) to take 30% less damage for 8 sec and gain the Shield of Vengeance barrier.
2: [우선 처치] Put Execution Sentence (1 min) on the Ritual Chieftain and focus Final Verdict on it.

[광역 피해] Line up Divine Protection with Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group, absorbs the next 162029 healing). Divine Protection reduces all damage regardless of school, so it works on Physical damage too.
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, take one with Rebuke. If kicks run short, stun another Serpent with Hammer of Justice to stop its Piercing Hiss.

[광역 피해] If the Divine Protection (42 sec) used on pull 2 is not back for Blood Sacrifice, the Templar build presses Wake of Ashes for the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier (10% of max health), and the Herald of the Sun build spends spare Holy Power on Word of Glory on yourself.
4: [우선 처치] Focus Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on the Ritual Chieftain and press Divine Protection for Blood Sacrifice. Take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Rebuke.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. If the Avenging Wrath (2 min) used on pull 1 is back, press it with Wake of Ashes and Divine Toll, and put Execution Sentence on the Ritual Chieftain to melt it first.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection when Blood Sacrifice overlaps with the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots DoTs. If your health is still in danger, use Divine Shield (3.5 min with Unbreakable Spirit, immune to all damage for 8 sec).
[회피] Dodge Toxic Breath (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec) by swinging to the Harrower's side quickly with Divine Steed (2 charges with Cavalier).
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Rebuke, and stun Evolve (6 sec channel) with Hammer of Justice to deny the shield and crowd-control immunity.
[제어] When the three Bloodletters gather in front of the tank, hold them together with Blinding Light to stop the melee swings that leave blood pools.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec). If an unkicked Envenom left a Nature DoT on a party member, clear it first with Cleanse Toxins (8 sec) so the two do not overlap.
8: [제어] Hold all four Bloodletters with Blinding Light to stop their melee swings. If the Blinding Light (1.5 min) used on pull 7 is not back, stop one with Hammer of Justice.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Rattle. If the tank took Corrosive Fangs (242456 Nature, 20% more damage taken for 20 sec) and Rattle lands on top of it, cast Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min) on the tank to take 30% of their damage for 12 sec.
9: [차단] Kick the nearby High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Rebuke and leave the one standing far to the left to the ranged kicker. Stop Evolve channels with Hammer of Justice (10 yd).
[우선 처치] Put Execution Sentence on a High Evolutionist and focus Final Verdict to kill them before the second Mass Envenom.
11: [차단] Kick your assigned High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Rebuke. When several channel Evolve together, disorient them at once with Blinding Light (10 yd) to stop the channels, and stop the last one with Hammer of Justice.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so if Avenging Wrath is back, line it up with Execution Sentence on this mini-boss.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection when Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd). If the tank is in danger from Noxious Spray (67888 Nature every sec for 5 sec), cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank.
13: [우선 처치] Focus Final Verdict on Ula'tek's Chosen. Pouring Execution Sentence, Divine Toll, Wake of Ashes and Divine Storm into the six Living Venoms at once makes their Venom Burst go off together, so spread them out.
[차단] Mass Envenom from the Chosen must be kicked every time, so save Rebuke (15 sec) for the Chosen.
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), and during it stun one Blade of the Altar with Hammer of Justice to stop its Laced Edge teleports.
14: [광역 피해] If the Divine Protection (42 sec) used on pull 13 is not back for Toxic Surge, the Templar build presses Wake of Ashes for the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier and takes it with that. Leave the Toxic Beam line (339438 Nature) with Divine Steed.
[제어] If Hammer of Justice is not back during Toxic Surge, hold the two Blades of the Altar near you with Blinding Light.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Rebuke.
[회피] Step out to the side of Twinfang Harrower's Toxic Breath frontal quickly with Divine Steed.
16: [우선 처치] If Avenging Wrath is back, press it with Execution Sentence and Divine Toll to kill Ula'tek's Chosen before the second Toxic Surge. Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom with Rebuke.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back, so take the first with Divine Protection and survive the second with the Templar build's Sacrosanct Crusade barrier or Word of Glory.
[참고] Blessing of Protection (5 min, immune to Physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec) on a low-health party member blocks Blood Sacrifice, which is Physical damage. Do not use it on the tank.

1: [광역 피해] This Bloodlust pull brings Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together. Press Avenging Wrath (2 min), add Wake of Ashes and Divine Toll, and put Execution Sentence (1 min) on the Captain, which dies first.

[해제] When Heartstop Poison stacks from the two Street Sneaks build on the tank, use Cleanse Toxins on the tank first. Its 8 sec cooldown frees only one player at a time, so split targets with the healer.
2: [차단] Take one of the two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) with Rebuke (15 sec). Sayaads are demons and are stunned for 5 sec by Wake of Ashes, so if both stand within 14 yd in front of you, stop them together with Wake of Ashes.
3: [차단] Kick the two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles channel with Rebuke when it is spare, and stop the other one with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 6 sec stun).
4: [해제] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks build fast. Use Cleanse Toxins (8 sec) on the tank every time it is ready.
[차단] Kick Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles with Rebuke.
5: [우선 처치] Focus Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on the Massive Felwyrm. It casts a 5 sec Massive Fel Detonation on death (290947 Fire within 10 yd), so leave 10 yd with Divine Steed (2 charges with Cavalier).

[광역 피해] When Over-infused's Burning Fel (38793 Fire every 3 sec) overlaps with a Corroding Spittle DoT, press Divine Protection (42 sec with Unbreakable Spirit) to take 30% less damage for 8 sec and gain the Shield of Vengeance barrier.
8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast) with Rebuke. If it finishes, the Flayer takes 60% less damage and is immune to crowd control for 1 min. If both Flayers cast together, gather them in front of you and stun them for 5 sec with Wake of Ashes (Flayers are demons).

[광역 피해] When Shivan Punisher activates Demonic Frenzy below 50% (29095 Fire every sec), stack Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on the Punisher and take it with Divine Protection. Leave Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd) with Divine Steed.
9: [참고] If Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life targets you, press Divine Protection. If it is still dangerous, cut the damage with Divine Shield (3.5 min with Unbreakable Spirit, immune to all damage for 8 sec).
[우선 처치] When the Warlock casts its Dark Pact shield (30% of max health) at 50%, break it right away with Execution Sentence and Final Verdict.
[제어] The two Wrathguard Flayers and eight Demon Flies are all demons, so Wake of Ashes can stun them together for 5 sec. Use Wake of Ashes to stop a Fel Rage cast you could not kick with Rebuke.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (30 sec channel) with Rebuke, and stun the second Invoker with Hammer of Justice to stop it.
[광역 피해] If Avenging Wrath is back, press it for Shivan Punisher's Demonic Frenzy below 50%, and take the Frenzy damage with Divine Protection.
11: [우선 처치] Stack Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on Felmaster Lucsei so Blade Dance does not come more than three times.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for the first Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec), and take the next one with the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier (10% of max health) from Wake of Ashes in the Templar build.
13: [제어] The six Unleashed Imps and two Wrathguard Flayers are all demons, so aiming Wake of Ashes (30 sec) at the pack stuns them for 5 sec and stops their Felfire Burst and Fel Rage casts together.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to the whole group), and line up Avenging Wrath on the Golem if it is back. Dodge Fel Beam by moving backward with Divine Steed.
14: [제어] Unleashed Imps, Wrathguard Flayers and Trained Felhunters are all demons, so stun the whole pack for 5 sec with every Wake of Ashes. Felhunter melee swings stop too, which pauses the Shadow Bite damage on the tank.
[차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Rebuke.
15: [참고] While the Corrupted Warlock is pulled back and killed first, press Divine Protection if Drain Life targets you, and break its Dark Pact shield with Execution Sentence and Final Verdict.
[광역 피해] For the Demonic Frenzy of the Shivan Punisher killed after the Warlock, press Avenging Wrath if it is back, and stun the three Trained Felhunters for 5 sec with Wake of Ashes.
16: [광역 피해] Stack Avenging Wrath, Execution Sentence and Divine Toll on the Defiled Golem to finish it within two AoE casts, and press Divine Protection for Defiled Slam.
[차단] Split the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice.

1: [광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull, so press Avenging Wrath (2 min) and add Wake of Ashes, Divine Toll and Execution Sentence.

[우선 처치] Put Final Verdict into Spirit of Hunger's Starvation Effigy totem and break it before Insatiable Hunger curses stack twice. Press Divine Protection (42 sec with Unbreakable Spirit) for the Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec) to take 30% less damage for 8 sec and gain the Shield of Vengeance barrier.

[참고] When the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking) pile up on a DPS or healer, cast Blessing of Protection (5 min) on them to block Physical damage for 10 sec. Do not use it on the tank (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Earthwhisper Tender's Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) and Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) must both be stopped, so kick one with Rebuke (15 sec) and stop the other with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 6 sec stun).
[우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem first with Final Verdict, and press Divine Protection for the Feast of Misery channel.
3: [차단] Split Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze and Earth Bolt between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice.

[우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem first with Final Verdict. If the Divine Protection (42 sec) used on pull 2 is not back for Feast of Misery, the Templar build presses Wake of Ashes for the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier (10% of max health) and takes it with that.
4: [우선 처치] Break the Starvation Effigy totem first with Final Verdict, and press Divine Protection for Feast of Misery.
[참고] Spend spare Holy Power on Word of Glory for party members stacking Razor Dive bleeds from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers. The Blessing of Protection (5 min) used on pull 1 is not back yet.
5: [차단] Split Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze and Earth Bolt between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice. The tank drags the pack while the group clicks the barrels, so follow the Tender to where it stands casting and stop it there.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss, so press Avenging Wrath if the one used on pull 1 is back. If the two Territorial Matriarchs' Mother's Wrath stacks put the tank in danger, cast Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min) on the tank to take 30% of their damage for 12 sec.

[차단] Split the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze and Earth Bolt between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice, and when both cast while standing together, stop them at once with Blinding Light (1.5 min, 6 sec disorient within 10 yd).
8: [우선 처치] Focus Execution Sentence (1 min) and Final Verdict on Terra Rumbler to break its Rumbling Ward shield (24246 Nature to the whole group every 2 sec for 1 min) quickly.
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull. Line up Execution Sentence, Divine Toll and Wake of Ashes with Bloodlust, and add Avenging Wrath if it is back. Put Execution Sentence on the Terra Rumbler shield to break it.
[차단] Kick one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% Haste and movement speed reduction) with Rebuke.
[참고] If Frigid Roar slows the tank, cast Blessing of Freedom (25 sec) on the tank so they ignore movement impairing effects for 8 sec. Unbound Freedom gives you the same effect (Wowhead).
10: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust, so press Avenging Wrath here if you could not use it on pull 9.
[차단] The two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar has a long cast and is easy to stop. Kick one with Rebuke and stop the other with Hammer of Justice.
11: [우선 처치] Focus Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on Avatar of Determination, then break the Terra Rumbler shield.
[회피] When Avatar casts Pulverize (4 sec cast, 12 yd stun and 387930 Physical), leave 12 yd with Divine Steed. If you get stunned, press Divine Protection, which is usable while stunned.
13: [차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets) with Rebuke, and break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem (36368 Fire every 0.3 sec) right away with Final Verdict.
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for the two Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echo (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking).
14: [광역 피해] This is a candidate pull for the third Bloodlust. If Bloodlust goes out here, press Avenging Wrath with it, and if it is saved for Loa Speaker Nanea or Nalorakk, save Avenging Wrath until then too.
[우선 처치] Break the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems right away with Final Verdict, and kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Rebuke.
[제어] When Bonded Beasttamer's Loyal Saberfang enrages with Bestial Wrath and chases one player, stun it for 6 sec with Hammer of Justice.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers take turns casting Primal Echo, so press Divine Protection (42 sec) on every other one and survive the ones in between with the Templar build's Sacrosanct Crusade barrier or Word of Glory. If it is still dangerous, use Divine Shield (3.5 min with Unbreakable Spirit).
[차단] Split the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice, and break Magma Totems right away with Final Verdict.
16: [차단] Put Rebuke into the kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt.

[우선 처치] Volatile Totems must be done by the second wave, so break the totems together with Divine Toll (up to 5 targets within 30 yd) and Divine Storm. If Bloodlust goes out here on high keys, line up Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence with it. If Nanea is around 10% health, finish Nanea first with Final Verdict.
[회피] If you are targeted by Earthquake, leave the group with Divine Steed and drop the pool away from them.

1: [광역 피해] This Bloodlust pull takes the first corridor all the way to the Voidtouched Magi. Press Avenging Wrath (2 min) and add Wake of Ashes, Divine Toll and Execution Sentence.

[차단] Take one of the two Enthralled Shamans' Lava Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) with Rebuke (15 sec), and stop Dominated Brawler's Demoralizing Shout by stunning it with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 6 sec stun).

[광역 피해] If you are targeted by the Magi's Null Eruption (145474 Shadow within 10 yd, 5 sec DoT), leave the group and press Divine Protection (42 sec with Unbreakable Spirit) to take 30% less damage for 8 sec and gain the Shield of Vengeance barrier.
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons three orbs with Orb of Disruption, hit all three at once with Divine Toll (up to 5 targets within 30 yd) and finish them with Final Verdict.
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Thundering Storm's group-wide damage.
3: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 158 trash. Put Execution Sentence, Divine Toll and Wake of Ashes into the pack, and if the Avenging Wrath used on pull 1 is back, press it when Chitigoth appears.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature to the whole group every 2 sec for 10 sec). When Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, stack Final Verdict on Brutok.
[참고] When Savage Leap bleeds from the five Feral Saberons stack on the tank, cast Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min) on the tank to take 30% of their damage for 12 sec.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area, so save Rebuke for the Screamer. Stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Hammer of Justice.

[광역 피해] If Watchful Harrower's Void Beam targets you (43642 Shadow within 8 yd every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), leave the group and press Divine Protection. Leave the whirlwind left after the Sky Strike soak right away with Divine Steed (2 charges with Cavalier).
6: [우선 처치] Until Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield breaks, each slam raises the group's Physical damage taken by 10%. Press Avenging Wrath if it is back and pour it into the shield with Execution Sentence and Divine Toll.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection when Brutal Slams damage gets high, and if Macestorm targets you (77586 Physical within 8 yd every sec for 6 sec), move away from the group with Divine Steed and keep moving.
8: [광역 피해] This is a damage cooldown pull (Topicx). Press Avenging Wrath and add Wake of Ashes and Divine Toll. Kill the low-health mob that Devouring Brutalizer targets with Devour (9 sec cast) using Final Verdict before the cast ends.
[차단] Spend Rebuke on Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek first, and stun Voidminder's Mending Void (20 sec channel) with Hammer of Justice to stop it.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Dreadbellow (29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled). If the tank is in danger from the Brutalize that follows (678877 Physical every 1.5 sec for 6 sec), cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank.
9: [차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Rebuke, and stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt or Voidminder's Mending Void with Hammer of Justice.

[광역 피해] If the Divine Protection (42 sec) used on pull 8 is not back for Dreadbellow, the Templar build presses Wake of Ashes for the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier (10% of max health), and the Herald of the Sun build spends spare Holy Power on Word of Glory on yourself.
10: [차단] Split the two Voidminders' Mending Void between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice.

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection when Dreadbellow overlaps with Watchful Harrower's Void Beam, and use Divine Shield (3.5 min with Unbreakable Spirit) if it is still dangerous. Cast Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank taking Brutalize again if the one used on pull 8 (2 min) is back.

1: [광역 피해] This is the dungeon's first pull, so Bloodlust goes out here (Topicx). Press Avenging Wrath (2 min) and put Wake of Ashes, Divine Toll and Execution Sentence (1 min) where the two Animated Guardians and the Shadow-Borne Champion are stacked.

[광역 피해] For Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd), press Divine Protection (42 sec with Unbreakable Spirit) to take 30% less damage for 8 sec and gain the Shield of Vengeance barrier.
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT) with Rebuke (15 sec). Risen Hexer and Shadow-Borne Champion cannot be stunned, so Hammer of Justice and Wake of Ashes cannot stop them.

[광역 피해] The corner pack is a cooldown pull (Topicx). Put Execution Sentence and Divine Toll in again, and take Shadow Whirlwind with Divine Protection if it is back from pull 1; otherwise use the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier (10% of max health) from Wake of Ashes in the Templar build.
4: [차단] Put Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (10 sec charm) and Soul Bolt and Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending into the Rebuke rotation. Bloodsworn Assassins and Guard Captain Atu are undead and can be stunned, so stun them together for 5 sec with Wake of Ashes to delay Captain's Bulwark.

[광역 피해] Press damage cooldowns only after the tank has threat on the awakened pack (Topicx). Save Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence for the hardest pack, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins.

[참고] If Blood Drain (164870 Physical) comes while Sudden Rupture (18 sec Physical bleed) is on you, press Divine Protection. If King A'akul's Mortal Bleed and Blood Drain stack on the tank, use Blessing of Sacrifice (2 min) on the tank. Leave King Timalji's Bladestorm with Divine Steed (2 charges with Cavalier).
5: [광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole group). If Bloodlust goes out here on high keys, line up Avenging Wrath with it (Topicx).

[해제] The pulled-in Embalming Fluids' Putrid Seekers is a poison and slows movement by 20%. Remove the poison with Cleanse Toxins (8 sec), and put Blessing of Freedom (25 sec) on a party member who is caught in the pool and backing up too slowly (Wowhead).
6: [차단] Take one of the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec disease DoT on the whole group) with Rebuke. Remove a missed disease (116379 Nature every 2 sec) with Cleanse Toxins.
7: [차단] Take one of the other two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge with Rebuke as well, and remove a missed disease with Cleanse Toxins.
[해제] When Putrid Seekers poison and slow from the eight Embalming Fluids build up, alternate Cleanse Toxins and Blessing of Freedom (Wowhead). Kill the Embalming Fluids together with Divine Storm.
9: [제어] Royal Berserkers, Spectral Shamans and Phantom Hex Priests are all stunnable undead. Keep the six of them within 14 yd in front of you and use Wake of Ashes (30 sec) to stun them together for 5 sec, which stops Hex and Healing Tide Totem casts. If Wake of Ashes is on cooldown, stop the pack with Blinding Light (1.5 min, 6 sec disorient within 10 yd) (Wowhead).

[차단] Stop the two Phantom Hex Priests' Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph) and Spectral Bolt by kicking one with Rebuke and stunning the other with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 6 sec stun).
[우선 처치] Focus Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on the two Spectral Shamans so no more Healing Tide Totems come out (Topicx).
10: [광역 피해] On a four-Bloodlust route this pull is the third Bloodlust (Topicx). Melt the Ghostly Brute first with Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence. The Ghostly Brute cannot be stunned.

[회피] When you see Ghostly Brute's Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby), run out of range with Divine Steed. After Soul Crush (727368 Physical) the tank takes 30% more Physical damage for 15 sec, so use Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank.
[제어] Spectral Shamans, Honored Raptors and the Phantom Hex Priest are stunnable undead, so stun them together for 5 sec with Wake of Ashes.
12: [참고] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage goes to the first player to engage, so put in Execution Sentence and Final Verdict after the tank is on it (Topicx). Shadow of Zul is humanoid and is not stunned by Wake of Ashes.
[위치] If you get Dark Revelation, use Divine Steed to get more than 20 yd from the group, and take the explosion 5 sec later (473120 Shadow) with Divine Protection.
[제어] The Minion of Zul spawned by Dark Revelation fears players who come close, so prevent the fear with Blinding Light (Wowhead).

1: [차단] Always kick one of the two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield channel (a shield every 3 sec for 15 sec that grants crowd control immunity) with Rebuke (15 sec).

[제어] When Deepstone Earthshaper's Tectonic Strike stacks get high on the tank, stop the Earthshaper with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 6 sec stun) (Topicx). Mobs in this dungeon are not demons or undead, so Wake of Ashes does not stun them.

[광역 피해] This is a big pull gathered up to the entrance corridor, so line up Avenging Wrath (2 min) and Execution Sentence (1 min) on the crowd-control-immune Primal Juggernaut and kill it first. Press Divine Protection (42 sec with Unbreakable Spirit) for Excavating Blast (106681 Nature within 60 yd plus an 8 sec DoT).
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Rebuke, and stop the Deepstone Earthshaper with Hammer of Justice to break the Tectonic Strike stacks.
[우선 처치] Focus Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on the Primal Juggernaut. Do not touch the eggs in the water, and use Divine Storm only where the mobs are stacked.
3: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Rebuke, and stop whichever of the two Deepstone Earthshapers is stacking Tectonic Strike with Hammer of Justice.

[광역 피해] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage spreads 24246 Fire within 60 yd six times, so press Divine Protection if your health is low. When the Blazing Rush charge comes toward the wall, get out of its path with Divine Steed (2 charges with Cavalier).
5: [차단] Use Rebuke on the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt first (Topicx). Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) cannot be interrupted, so stop one with Hammer of Justice and the other with Blinding Light (1.5 min, 6 sec disorient within 10 yd).

[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno (96982 Fire within 60 yd plus a 5 sec DoT), and when Burnout (484912 Fire within 20 yd) comes as the Destroyer dies, leave 20 yd with Divine Steed.
[위치] If you get Living Bomb, move away with Divine Steed so the 6 yd explosion 6 sec later does not reach the group.
6: [광역 피해] Flamegullet's Molten Blood group damage keeps growing below 50%, so line up Avenging Wrath and Execution Sentence with the 50% window and kill it fast. On +17 and higher, Bloodlust goes out at this 50% (Topicx).
[차단] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Hammer of Justice and kick Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Rebuke. Leave the Flame Breath cone with Divine Steed.
7: [차단] Kick the two Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt with Rebuke, and split the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage between Hammer of Justice and Blinding Light.
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno, and when you see the Burnout cast, leave 20 yd with Divine Steed.
8: [차단] Kick the two Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt with Rebuke, and split the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage between Hammer of Justice and Blinding Light. Make sure disoriented mobs do not wander toward the patrolling Thunderhead.
[광역 피해] If Avenging Wrath is back, line it up on the Blazebound Destroyer, and press Divine Protection for Inferno.
10: [광역 피해] Six Storm Warriors are stacked in this pull, so cut them down together with Wake of Ashes, Divine Toll and Divine Storm. Press Divine Protection when several Thunderous Stomps (53340 Nature within 60 yd) overlap.
[차단] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Hammer of Justice. If Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec) targets you, take it with Divine Protection.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Rebuke, and if Lightning Torrent targets you while Divine Protection is on cooldown, put up the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier (10% of max health) with Wake of Ashes in the Templar build.
12: [광역 피해] While High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield (a barrier of 20% of max health) is up, the group takes 29095 Nature every sec, so stack Avenging Wrath, Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on Ryvati to break it fast. On high keys, line them up with Bloodlust if the group uses it here (Topicx).

[참고] If the barrier expires unbroken, everyone within 60 yd is stunned for 4 sec. If you cannot break it in time, block the stun with Divine Shield (3.5 min with Unbreakable Spirit, immune to damage and harmful effects for 8 sec) and keep dealing damage.

1: [우선 처치] Kill the crowd-control-immune Sandfury Stonefist first (Topicx). Stack Avenging Wrath (2 min), Execution Sentence (1 min) and Final Verdict on the Stonefist, and press Divine Protection (42 sec with Unbreakable Spirit) for Ground Pound (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yd plus a knockback).

[차단] Take one of the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt with Rebuke (15 sec), and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Hammer of Justice (30 sec with Fist of Justice, 6 sec stun). Do not miss kicks when Ground Pound and Lightning Bolt overlap (Topicx).
[해제] Shrouded Fang's Poisoned Cheap Shot (5 sec stun and 96982 Nature every sec) is a poison, so remove it right away with Cleanse Toxins (8 sec) (Wowhead).
2: [해제] Remove the two Shrouded Fangs' Poisoned Cheap Shot poison with Cleanse Toxins. Its cooldown is 8 sec, so split with the healer if two players are hit at once.
[차단] Kick the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt with Rebuke, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Hammer of Justice. Press Divine Protection again for Ground Pound if it is back from pull 1.
4: [우선 처치] If Sand-Sworn Rider lives long, its Swarming Krolusks adds jump on distant party members, so stack Execution Sentence and Final Verdict on the Rider (Topicx).
[해제] Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin (72737 Nature plus 38793 every sec for 10 sec) is a poison, so remove it with Cleanse Toxins (Wowhead). Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Rebuke.
5: [차단] A Lightning Bolt landing on someone hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin kills them (Topicx). Split the two Storm Adepts between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice, and free the Cytotoxin target with Cleanse Toxins first.
[광역 피해] Casters, the Krolusk Matriarch and the Sand-Sworn Rider come together in this big pull, so if Avenging Wrath is back, press it when the Rider joins and put Execution Sentence on the Rider.
6: [차단] One player is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast), so take it with Rebuke (Topicx), and stop Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Hammer of Justice.
[해제] Remove Poisonous Viper's Cytotoxin with Cleanse Toxins.
7: [해제] Three Poisonous Vipers keep applying Cytotoxin, so use Cleanse Toxins every time it is ready. Free the player who also has a Venom Bolt landing on top of the poison first (Topicx).

[차단] Kick Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind and Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Rebuke, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Hammer of Justice. If several casters overlap, stop them together with Blinding Light (1.5 min, 6 sec disorient within 10 yd) (Wowhead).
9: [광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole group). If the two Nimbuses' Release Charges are staggered, take the second one with the Sacrosanct Crusade barrier (10% of max health) from Wake of Ashes in the Templar build.
[차단] Keep kicking Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt with Rebuke even while Release Charge is going off (Topicx).
10: [차단] Stop the two Imbued Stormcallers before gathering the rest (Topicx). Kick one with Rebuke and stop the other with Hammer of Justice, and if both cast at once, stop them together with Blinding Light.
[광역 피해] This is a dangerous pull with a Nimbus, casters and several Static Anomalies, so press Avenging Wrath and line up Divine Protection with Release Charge.
12: [차단] Temple Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel stops the orb from charging, so kick the Disruptor on the tank's side with Rebuke and hold the Disruptor on the far side with Hammer of Justice (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Press Divine Protection for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT), and hit the gathered Faithless Conscripts together with Divine Storm and Divine Toll.
13: [차단] Split the second orb's Temple Disruptors between Rebuke and Hammer of Justice as well, and press Divine Protection for Caustic Stomp. If Avenging Wrath is back, line it up on the Orb Watcher.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer is immune to crowd control, so only Rebuke can stop its Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT). Keep to the kick rotation.

[제어] The four Faithless Tormentors chase only the healer, so stop one with Hammer of Justice and kill them fast with Wake of Ashes and Divine Storm (Topicx). If Latent Hex targets you, leave the group with Divine Steed (2 charges with Cavalier).
